Dev.releaseNotes:
`refactor` (`filters`): **Store every filter expression's values as `Parameter` and `SecondParameter`**:

- A contract resolver stores each expression by its container members, so the classes naming their values themselves (`InSeason`, `InYear`, `Switch`, the character and creator ones) no longer get keys of their own
- A schema step moves the old keys of stored presets over, a season, appearance or role becoming its name and a removed one unset
- Wrote the stored shape into the filters readme

`fix` (`db`): **Widen the language columns of `StoredReleaseInfo`**:

- Doubled `AudioLanguages` and `SubtitleLanguages` to 1024 characters on MySQL and SQL Server; a release with many subtitle languages overflowed 512 and aborted its job chain

`refactor` (`filters`): **Make filter parameters nullable and leave out parts with nothing to work with**:

- Every filter parameter is nullable, enums and time spans included; only `null` is unset, so `0`, `""`, `false` and `[]` are set
- Conditions, source selectors and date functions without a value they need, and comparers without a usable `Left` and right side, no longer take part
- `FilterFactory` and stored filters keep `null` as `null`; a `0` number is no longer dropped

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.110**.

`refactor` (`filters`): **Replace `IsSwitchedOff` with `IsApplicable`, leaving missing inputs out too**:

- A gate with a missing input now acts as its other input, as with a switched-off one, so saved single-input gates match the editor's preview
- An empty `Not`, `Scope` or gate drops out of its parent
- Wrote the rule into the filters readme

`fix` (`filters`): **Let a set `Right` win over `Parameter` in the string comparers**:

- The string and string set comparers used `Parameter` when both were set, unlike the number and date ones
- Wrote the rule into the filters readme

`feat` (`plugin`): **Give the core plugin the Shoko logo as its icon and thumbnail**:

- Shipped `Shoko.Server.icon.svg` (the docs logo, squared) and `Shoko.Server.thumbnail.svg` (16:9, the logo on the generic plugin background) beside the dll, where the plugin loader finds them without writing anything

`feat` (`filters`): **Add `SwitchExpression`**:

- Added a switch around a condition: off or empty it fails, on it passes as its `Left` does; its label never changes the result
- The logic gates leave a switched-off or empty switch out (`IsSwitchedOff`), and `Not` and `Scope` pass it up
- Fixed `EqualsExpression.UserDependent` reading the right side's `TimeDependent`

`fix` (`core`): **Apply `Import.Exclude` patterns to directories** ([#1464](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/ShokoServer/pull/1464)):

**What**:

`CoreIgnoreRule.ShouldIgnore` returned `false` for every entry that is not a `FileInfo`, so `Import.ExcludeExpressions` never matched a folder — even though scans pass directories to ignore rules and the walker prunes a rejected directory together with its whole subtree (`FileSystemHelpers.GetFileSystemEntryPaths`, the `canProceed(directory, true)` branch).

That made the documented contract unreachable. A pattern like `[\/]!SomeTree[\/]` filtered the *files* inside that tree, but the walk still enumerated it — the expensive part — and every nested directory with a plugin rule was still descended into.

**Changes**:

- The rule now matches directories as well as files; the file path is untouched.
- A directory path gets the platform separator appended before a single pass over the patterns. `DirectoryInfo.FullName` never ends with a separator, so a pattern written as a directory prefix (the shipped defaults are `[\\/]\.Trash-\d+[\\/]`) matched only the children and pruned one level too late.
- `Shoko.Abstractions/Video/README.md` no longer claims the built-in rule is file-only.

`docs`: **Ask for plugin icons readable at 24 pixels, not 16**:

No client draws a plugin icon below 24 pixels; the Web UI draws source
icons at that size.

`repo` (`deps`): **Bump `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets` to `0.5.0` in `Shoko.Plugin.LegacyPlex`**:

Dropped the plugin's own `EnableDynamicLoading`, which the targets now default.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Let a build for this server replace a legacy plugin, and refuse an older major ABI**:

A legacy plugin has no ID of its own, so installing its 6.x build left
the 5.x one behind as a second plugin that still failed the start.

- Replaced an enabled legacy plugin with an installed build of the same
  assembly for this server
- Refused a plugin built for an older major version of
  `Shoko.Abstractions` when loading it, which only the installer
  checked before; it fails the start like a legacy plugin does
- Said in both reasons what the admin can do about it

Co-authored-by: revam <7761729+revam@users.noreply.github.com>

`fix` (`buildtools`): **Default `EnableDynamicLoading` in `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets`**:

- A `build/Shoko.BuildTools.Targets.props` set `EnableDynamicLoading` to `true` when the project leaves it unset, so a plain `dotnet build` copies a plugin's own NuGet dependencies as `shoko-build` does
- The README and the package's readme said so, and how a project that is not a plugin opts out

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.5.0**.

`refactor`: **Keep only what each side uses in the dependency list copies**:

- The server's copy dropped `Format`, which only the build tools write with, and each copy's note named the copies the others keep, each with what its side uses

`refactor` (`buildtools`): **Read plugin dependencies from the project, as `PluginDependency` items**:

- `shoko-build` and `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets` read `<PluginDependency Include="<id>" Version="..." Optional="..." />` items below `--dependencies` and the `PluginDependencies` property, and stopped reading a manifest's top-level `dependencies`, warning when one still lists them
- The property beside items warned that it wins, and a bad item stopped the build naming it
- The schema dropped the top-level field, and the README and both NuGet readmes documented the items as where a plugin's dependencies belong

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.6.0**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.4.0**.

`fix` (`airing`): **List airings that share a time in episode order**:

Airings at the same time were ordered by link, channel and key, so a batch
release came out scrambled (`#10` before `#2`, or by GUID in the lists).

- Added `AiringEpisodeOrder` (anime, episode type, episode number) as the
  first tie-break after the time in `GetAiringsInRange`, the calendar days
  and the series and schedule airing lists

`fix` (`tray`): **Start the server off the UI thread**:

`StartAsync` resumed its awaits on the Avalonia UI thread, which was blocked
waiting for it, so the start hung whenever the plugin update check before the
scan had to sync a repository.

Closes #1463

`fix` (`api`): **Read quoted line breaks in cross-reference CSV imports**:

`Quote` wrapped fields holding a line break, but `Read` split the file
line by line, so such a field broke its row on import. A quoted field now
carries on into the next line, and an unclosed quote is a line error.

`fix` (`metadata`): **Read AniDB people and studios through the stores**:

- `IMetadataPeopleStore` and `IMetadataStudioStore` answered nothing for `anidb` IDs; they now read the AniDB tables
- Writes still refuse `anidb`

`feat` (`metadata`): **Add removal and credit events to the people and studio stores**:

- `EntitiesRemoved` on `IMetadataPeopleStore` and `IMetadataStudioStore`, from `RemoveOrphaned` and the AniDB refresh
- `CreditsChanged` on `IMetadataPeopleStore`, when an entry's cast or crew changed

`fix` (`anidb`): **List an AniDB studio's works from its studio roles**:

`AniDB_Studio.GetAnime()` read the voice-actor join, so every AniDB studio had no works.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.109**.

`repo` (`deps`): **Pin a fixed `System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs` in the queue processor**:

`Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` 6.1, under EF Core's SQL Server provider, brings 9.0.11, flagged by GHSA-2fmv-rv2c-59x7 and GHSA-846f-f764-76mx, so every plugin on `Shoko.QueueProcessor` saw NU1902/NU1903.

`chore` (`queue`): **Bump `Shoko.QueueProcessor` to `6.0.0-alpha.13`**.

`repo` (`deps`): **Bump `MessagePack` to 3.1.12**:

Past GHSA-qhrr-8q5h-9q3h, where nested arrays could read past buffer length limits.

`repo` (`deps`): **Drop the legacy `Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR` package**:

- It contributed no runtime assets next to the shared framework's SignalR, only an old `SignalR.Core` flagged by GHSA-334f-vvp4-7g6p
- Moved `Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Protocols.NewtonsoftJson` to 10.0.13 for the fixed `SignalR.Common`, and `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions` with it

`fix` (`buildtools`): **Ship Roslyn next to the tasks in `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets`**:

- Without a copy beside the tasks, MSBuild gave `ReadPluginIdentityFromSource` the SDK's Roslyn; inside `shoko-build`, which binds its own Roslyn 5.9, a newer SDK copy failed to load
- Copied `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis` and `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp` into the output and the package, beside `Shoko.BuildTools.Tasks.dll`
- Dropped Roslyn from the package's dependencies

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.3.4**.

`chore`: **Fix the Discord links**. (_Skip CI_)

`repo` (`workflows`): **Publish the NuGet packages from one matrix job**:

- Replaced the publish jobs with one `nuget` job over the packages, `Shoko.BuildTools.Analyzers` now among them
- Builds that waited on `plugin-nuget` now wait on `nuget`

`repo` (`workflows`): **Quote shell expansions and pin third-party actions to commit SHAs**:

- Quoted the expansions ShellCheck flagged and grouped the changelog writes
- `getsentry/action-release@v3` deprecated `version` for `release`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.108**.

`chore`: **Remove unnecessary casts**.

`repo`: **Ignore NuGet audit warnings**:

Moved the `NU1900`–`NU1904` advisories from `WarningsNotAsErrors` to `NoWarn` in `Directory.Build.props`, so they no longer show in any project, and dropped the server's own `NU1902`/`NU1903` entries.

`refactor` (`api`): **Answer the aggregate hub's feed calls with the joined feeds**:

- `feed.join_single`, `feed.join_many`, `feed.leave_single`, `feed.leave_many`, `feed.replace_all` and `feed.clear_all` return the connection's feeds afterwards, instead of a `bool` that could not tell an unknown feed, a refusal and a no-op apart
- The hub sends `feed.joined` with the connection's feeds once it opens, an empty list when its `feeds` query named none

`refactor` (`plugin`): **Install plugin upgrades before the plugin scan**:

- New `Plugins.Updates.IsUpgradeOnStartEnabled` (on by default, `SHOKO_PLUGIN_UPGRADE_ON_START_ENABLED`) installs the newest compatible release of each enabled, unpinned plugin before it loads, within 90 s, after fetching the repositories older than `RepositoryStaleTimeOnStart` (5 minutes)
- Auto-upgrade while running makes the same choice (`SelectUpgrades`); `IsAutoUpgradeEnabled` can be set by `SHOKO_PLUGIN_AUTO_UPGRADE_ENABLED`
- A release built for a newer server waits for the server upgrade while the older version loads; a version that fails is never passed over
- `SystemService` builds the one `PluginPackageManager`, and `POST /api/v3/Plugin/Package/Settings` saves once
- Dropped the `IsAutoSyncEnabled` switch, which the "Check Plugin Updates" triggers made redundant, and gave `InactivePluginVersionRetention` a `DefaultValue` that parses

`chore` (`tests`): **Drop and fold redundant tests**:

- Removed 194 tests that restated declared literals, exercised libraries or mocks, pinned a refactor or repeated another test's branch, and the fixtures only they read
- Folded 326 near-copies into 110 theories with the same cases

`fix` (`api`): **Report an empty episode number as a parse failure**:

`GetEpisodeNumberAndTypeFromInput` read `input[0]` of an empty string and threw, so an empty range bound answered 500. The skipped test recording it runs again.

`fix`: **Lock the latest episode stats in the parallel update**:

`UpdateMissingEpisodeStats` set `latestLocalEpNumber` and `lastEpAirDate` from an `AsParallel` loop without a lock, so a series could keep a stale latest episode or air date. The skipped test that caught it runs again.

`refactor`: **Drop `LearnAirTimeOffset` and `EstimateAirTime`**:

Only their tests called them since `LearnProfile` anchors its own samples and calls `LearnOffset`; the tests now call `LearnOffset` directly.

`refactor`: **Remember the types `SimpleNameSerializationBinder` finds**:

`BindToType` scanned the types of every scannable assembly on each call, once per node of every stored filter it read; it now looks each name up once. The filter tests went from 8 s to 4 s.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Halt the start on an enabled plugin that cannot load**:

- A plugin whose types failed to load, built for a newer `Shoko.Abstractions`, on the legacy namespace or with an invalid dependency list was read as disabled, so the server started without it
- It now keeps its enabled setting and fails the start, unless an older installed version loads in its place, as does a plugin refused at start for its dependencies
- A plugin missing a type of the server or the runtime is said to be built for another version of the server, naming the type

`fix` (`api`): **Accept sources and entity types stored in the database but not registered**:

- Routes and query values naming a metadata source or entity type only took registered ones, so the data of a plugin that was not loaded answered 404 though its rows were still stored
- `MetadataNumberRegistry.TryGetKnownSource` and `TryGetKnownEntityType` take a registered one or one the database has a number for

`refactor` (`metadata`): **Keep creator and character titles and overviews in the text store**:

- `ICreator` and `ICharacter` implement `IWithTitles` in place of `Name`, `OriginalName` and `AlternativeNames`; `MetadataCreatorData` and `MetadataCharacterData` take `Titles` and `Overviews` like `MetadataSeriesData`
- `IWithTitles` gained `OriginalLanguageCode`, `OriginalCountryCode`, `OriginalLanguage` and `OriginalTitle`, moved off `ISeries`/`IMovie`
- `Metadata_Creator` and `Metadata_Character` lose `Name`, `OriginalName` and `Description`, copied into `Metadata_Title` and `Metadata_Overview` first; a stub's credit name is its main title, and a nameless person reads as `<Source> Creator <id>`
- `AniDB_Creator`/`AniDB_Character` give their name as `x-jat` main and original name as `ja` official title; APIv3 keeps `Name`, `OriginalName` and `AlternativeNames` on people

`fix` (`metadata`): **Name seasons, creators and characters by the episode title orders**:

- Seasons followed the series title orders, though the episode settings always said they covered seasons
- Creators and characters are read alongside episodes, so they follow the same orders; one `TextChooser.UsesEpisodeTitleOrder` decides it everywhere

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Choose titles and overviews by steps of sources and languages**:

- `IMetadataTextManager.ChooseTitle` and `ChooseOverview` take a `TitleSelection` or `OverviewSelection`: steps of a source, or any source, and a language, walked in order; `GetTitleSelection` and `GetOverviewSelection` build the steps the settings make
- They replace `ChoosePreferredTitle`, `ChoosePreferredOverview` and `GetLanguageOrder`, and the core's own choices walk the same steps

`feat` (`api`): **Let admins limit CORS origins, and apply CORS to every endpoint**:

- New `Web.AllowedOrigins` (`SHOKO_CORS_ORIGINS`): empty or `*` allows any origin, as before; otherwise only the origins listed
- `UseCors` ran after `UseEndpoints`, so no endpoint's answer carried CORS headers; it now runs right after `UseRouting`, before the not-running check, so preflights work in setup and failure mode too

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Drop the default bodies of `LinksChanged` and `DefaultEnabledKinds`**:

- `IMetadataLinkingService.LinksChanged` no longer has a default that drops every handler
- `IMetadataProvider.DefaultEnabledKinds` defaults to `null` for every kind served, which the core already works out

`refactor`: **Make setters that ignore their value honest and merge overlapping overloads**:

- `Languages` forgets its lists through `Reset*` methods; the connectivity monitor and log level rule keys are get-only
- Renamed the log read action to `GetLogsByFileId`, and `FileUserData()` chains to the other constructor
- `GetFileInformationByHandle` takes the `SafeFileHandle`; dropped the unused `SearchInfo<T>` equality operators and an `inverted ^ false`

`fix`: **Dispose replaced database signals and drop an undisposed linked token source**.

`fix`: **Bound regexes with a match timeout**:

- `RegexUtility` holds one 2 s timeout, the default of .NET's `RegularExpressionAttribute`; `BoundedRegex` stops running a pattern after its first timeout and logs a warning naming it once
- Regex filters, import excludes, log filters and schema patterns count a timeout as no match; the APIv3 `PathRegex` and `FilenameRegex` searches answer a validation problem
- The other episodes field of AniDB `FILE` replies is matched without backtracking

`fix`: **Read the released plugins' manifests on every online build**:

The cached manifest was reused for a day, so a daily build right after a plugin release bundled the old one.

`docs`: **Correct five doc comments and a README line found by the plugin docs**:

- `RecurringJobRegistry` named a nonexistent `IPlugin.Load`
- Scheduled action minimum intervals and opt-ins in the README
- `PluginEventEmitter` sends only install and uninstall
- Image providers can be asked for networks
- Only `DownloadAlternateOrdering` in `MetadataRefreshOptions` is nullable

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Make configuration visibility opt-in instead of opt-out**:

- Replaced `IHiddenConfiguration` with `IVisibleConfiguration`
- Provider and plugin configuration interfaces no longer imply hidden
- `ConfigurationInfo.IsHidden` is `true` unless the type opts in

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.107**.

`fix` (`api`): **Leave the plugin out of the configuration nested in `/api/v3/Plugin`**:

`PluginInfo` and `ConfigurationInfo` built each other without end.

`refactor` (`scheduling`): **Run airing schedule jobs as one closed type per provider**:

- Made `RefreshAiringScheduleJob<TProvider>` and `SweepAiringScheduleProviderJob<TProvider>` provider jobs (`[ProviderJob]`), so a suspension holding an airing provider holds its refreshes and sweeps
- Added `AiringScheduleProviderJobs`; `PluginManager` registers the closed types and one `AiringScheduleSweepWatchdogThreshold` per sweep type
- Dropped the `ProviderID` job member; old queued rows of the removed types are dropped at start by the queue

`fix`: **Save the validated configuration after a migration on load**:

Saving the raw migrated JSON failed validation when an environment variable overrode one of its values, which stopped the server from starting.

`fix`: **Load the server settings in the main configuration tests instead of in `AddParts`**:

Reverted d449d1c37. A real start always loads them before `AddParts`, so only the test lacked them.
`fix`: **Carry the server settings over in `AddParts` only when they were loaded**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Let a plugin declare its main configuration**:

- Added `IPluginConfiguration` and `IPlugin<TConfiguration>`
- `AddParts` attaches it as `LocalPluginInfo.ConfigurationInfo`
- `/api/v3/Plugin` returns it as `Configuration`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.106**.

`fix`: **List a series on the dashboard after its first progress save**:

A video user data save without a watched change never recomputed the
series stats, so `AnimeSeries_User.LastVideoUpdate` stayed unset for a
series the user had not finished an episode of yet, and the dashboard's
continue watching and next up lists left it out until the series stats
were rebuilt.

- Bumped `LastVideoUpdate` on the series user data after such a save,
  creating the row when missing, instead of running the full recompute

`refactor`: **Move the TMDB plugin to its own repository**:

The plugin now lives in `ShokoAnime/Shoko.Plugin.Tmdb`, with its tests and
its API key stamping, and is released on its own.

- Removed `Shoko.Plugin.Tmdb`, its tests and fixtures, and `ReplaceTmdbApiKey.ps1` with its workflow steps
- Dropped it from `BundledPlugins.targets`, the solution and the tests that listed its assemblies

`refactor`: **Move the WebAOM plugin to its own repository**:

The plugin now lives in `ShokoAnime/Shoko.Plugin.WebAOM`, with its tests,
and is released on its own.

- Removed `Shoko.Plugin.WebAOM` and the renamer's tests
- Dropped it from `BundledPlugins.targets`, the solution and the tests that listed its assembly
- Checked the carry-over of the renamer's settings against stand-ins instead of the plugin

`repo`: **Bundle the released plugins, cached per plugin across runs**:

The offline importer, TMDB and WebAOM are released from their own
repositories; official builds bundle the latest stable release of each.

- Added `ReleasedPlugins.targets`, which reads each plugin's published manifest, checks the archive's SHA-256 and caches it like `MediaInfo.targets`, off unless `ShokoBundleReleasedPlugins` is set
- Fetched each plugin in its own CI job with its own cache entry, and built the server and the Docker images from that cache offline
- Let a sandboxed source build bundle them from a cache it fills itself with `ShokoReleasedPluginsOffline`

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Map the remaining language codes seen in end-user logs** ([#1461](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/ShokoServer/pull/1461)):

* fix(abstractions): map the remaining language codes seen in end-user logs

- Added 34 ISO 639 languages to `TitleLanguage`, appended after `Pali` so stored values keep their numbers, with `GetTitleLanguage`, `GetDescription` and `GetString` mappings.
- `mo` resolves to `Romanian` and `Spanish (Catalan|Galician|Basque)` to their own languages.
- `Undefined`, `Keine Angabe`, `unknown`, `instrumental`, `map`, `sh` and `hbs` stay `Unknown` and are no longer reported.
- Added `frs`, `kaa`, `rom` and `ace` to the `MediaInfoUtility` language table and spaced the `Hiri Motu`, `Sichuan Yi` and `South Ndebele` names.
- Re-ran `RepairRegionTaggedStreamLanguages` in a new schema version on all three backends, so streams stored with an empty language code for the new table entries get one. It skips null streams.

* refactor(abstractions): drop GetDescription cases that match the enum name

The default arm already returns the enum name.
`chore` (`plugin`): **Drop the taglines from the WebAOM and LegacyPlex thumbnails**.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Close the remaining ways a plugin can take the start down unnoticed**:

- Checked a plugin's references against the assemblies only a plugin it depends on ships, reading metadata on both sides in `PluginReferenceChecker`
- Failed a plugin whose export cannot be created for a start-up step, or whose constructor throws while it is scanned, where both were skipped with a warning
- Wrote a plugin traced to a failure that leaves no web server to `plugins/failed-starts.json`, so the next start leaves it out and says why

`fix` (`plugin`): **Read a downloaded package image only once it is written**:

`DownloadAndCacheImageAsync` checked the image while the file was still open
for writing, so the first download of every image failed with an empty file
and only the next sync found it.

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Migrate stored select values written before the UI namespace move** ([#1460](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/ShokoServer/pull/1460)):

Added `LegacySelectComponentMigration`, run from `ConfigurationService` on load ahead of schema validation, which renames the old lowercase `SelectComponent` keys (`options`, `groupId`, `selected`, ...) to their current names and saves the result back.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Sync never-synced repositories and check for updates before the database is up**:

- Counted a repository without a `LastFetchedAt` as stale in `GetAvailablePackageManifests`, so the ones the server adds fill in on first use
- Dropped the `ScheduledUpdate` row `CheckForUpdates` wrote and nothing read, which threw while there is no database, as in first-run setup and after a failed start

`refactor`: **Drop the last-run rows scheduled actions made redundant**:

- Stopped `GetAniDBCalendarJob` and `CheckAniDBFileUpdatesJob` writing a `ScheduledUpdate` row nothing reads; their actions keep the last run
- Removed the unused `ScheduledUpdateRepository` from `ActionService`

`chore`: **Remove unused usings**.
`chore` (`plugin`): **Recolour the WebAOM thumbnail and icon**.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Halt the start with the web host up when a plugin fails**:

A plugin built for an older contract threw in `ConfigurationService.AddParts`,
before the web host started, so the server exited and restart-looped.

- Recorded a plugin that fails while being loaded, registered, created or handed to the services (`LocalPluginInfo.HasFailed`, `FailureReason`), went on with the rest and halted the start as for a failed `Setup`
- Added `PluginReferenceChecker`, which fails a plugin referring to types or members the server no longer has before its assembly loads
- Left the plugin enabled; disabling it is the admin's choice
- Added a `failed` filter to `/api/v3/Plugin`

`repo` (`workflows`): **Stop bundling the offline importer**:

Removed the download job and its steps from the daily and release builds.
The plugin is installed like any other.

`feat` (`plugin`): **Ship the core and community plugin repositories**:

- Seeded the repositories the server ships with once, remembered by key in `Plugins.Updates.SeededRepositories` so one an admin removed stays removed: `core` enabled, `community` disabled
- Added `IPluginPackageManager.RestoreDefaultPackageRepositories` and `POST /api/v3/Plugin/Package/Repository/RestoreDefaults` to add the missing ones back
- Added `PackageRepositoryInfo.IsEnabled` with `EnablePackageRepository`, `DisablePackageRepository` and `PUT /api/v3/Plugin/Package/Repository/{repositoryID}`; a disabled repository is kept but not synced and its packages are not offered
- Added `PackageRepositoryInfo.Description`, set when a repository is added and not editable afterwards
